purpose: Construct a response-blind species-pair predictor for similarity of persistent climatic opportunity from the Last Glacial Maximum to the present.
biological_question: Among Palearctic Lepidoptera, do species with more similar LGM-to-present refugial-persistence geography show more reusable locations of post-IBD genetic turnover?

occurrence_training.rule_lineage: reuse the existing TTF-Q deterministic response-blind occurrence policy

sdm.reason: low-tuning response-blind climatic suitability model; avoid result-driven algorithm competition
sdm.training: fit current climatic centroid and shrinkage covariance from filtered current occurrences
sdm.suitability: exp(-0.5 * squared Mahalanobis distance), rescaled within species to [0,1]
sdm.projection: apply the same fitted climatic envelope to current and 21 ka climate grids

refugial_persistence.normalization: divide P_s by its cell sum before pairwise overlap
refugial_persistence.focal_relation: R_refugia(s,t) = Schoener D between normalized persistence surfaces
refugial_persistence.interpretation: shared geography of climatic suitability persistent from LGM to present; not direct proof of demographic refugia

mandatory_response_blind_controls: Schoener D between current suitability surfaces
directed current geographic co-opportunity from filtered occurrence coordinates
